about: Shared redaction rule for VPN diagnostics (onboarding spec 3.5). Run by tools/checks/vpn-selfcheck.mjs (desktop redactDiagnostics) and core DiagnosticsTest (Android redactDiagnostics). names: peer and self names, mapped to peer-1..n in order.

cases.name: stable peer map
cases.input: nas up, laptop down, Nas again
cases.expected: peer-1 up, peer-2 down, peer-1 again

cases.name: IPv6 before a colon (Go errors)
cases.input: self 2001:db8:1:2:3:4:5:6: up; route to 2001:db8:85a3::8a2e:370:7334: unreachable; listen fd7a:115c:a1e0::2: address in use; dial fd7a:115c:a1e0::2:41641
cases.expected: self 2001:…: up; route to 2001:…: unreachable; listen fd7a:…: address in use; dial fd7a:…:41641

cases.name: IPv6 after a colon (Go %+v structs)
cases.expected: {IP:fd7a:… Port:41641} Addr:fd7a:… src:2001:… dst:2001:… ip:fd7a:… up v6:2001:…

cases.name: short credentials
cases.input: Authorization: Bearer abc123 | Authorization: Basic dXNlcjpw, api_key=k1 X-Emby-Token q2 token: t3 Token="t4" {"Password":"p5"} secret=s6
cases.expected: Authorization: Bearer *** | Authorization: Basic ***, api_key=*** X-Emby-Token *** token: *** Token="***" {"Password":"***"} secret=***

cases.name: provider hosts stay
cases.input: management: https://api.netbird.io:443 ok, app.netbird.io, controlplane.tailscale.com up
cases.expected: management: https://api.netbird.io:443 ok, app.netbird.io, controlplane.tailscale.com up

cases.name: private hostnames
cases.input: dial nas.tail1234.ts.net:8096: timeout; peer laptop.netbird.cloud. offline

cases.name: management dial phase (tcp, LAN)
cases.input: last error: create connection: dial context: context deadline exceeded [failed at tcp connect to 192.168.1.20:443 (ipv4, lan): dial tcp 192.168.1.20:443: i/o timeout]
cases.expected: last error: create connection: dial context: context deadline exceeded [failed at tcp connect to 192.*.*.*:443 (ipv4, lan): dial tcp 192.*.*.*:443: i/o timeout]

cases.name: management dial phase (dns, tls)
cases.input: [failed at dns lookup: lookup netbird.example.org: no such host] [failed at tls handshake with [2001:db8::5]:443 (ipv6): x509: certificate is valid for proxy.example.org, not netbird.example.org]
cases.expected: [failed at dns lookup: lookup <host>: no such host] [failed at tls handshake with [2001:…]:443 (ipv6): x509: certificate is valid for <host>, not <host>]
